WHERE fx_market_data_state.pair_id = $1::INTEGER) AS anon_1, (SELECT coalesce(sum(fx_candle.gold_volume), $2::NUMERIC) AS coalesce_1 
FROM fx_candle 
WHERE fx_candle.pair_id = $3::INTEGER AND fx_candle.interval = $4::VARCHAR AND fx_candle.bucket_start >= $5::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE AND fx_candle.bucket_start < $6::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) AS anon_2, (SELECT coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN (fx_trade.side = $7::VARCHAR) THEN fx_trade.input_amount ELSE fx_trade.output_amount END), $8::NUMERIC) AS coalesce_3 
FROM fx_trade 
WHERE fx_trade.pair_id = $9::INTEGER AND fx_trade.created_at >= $10::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE AND fx_trade.created_at < $11::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) AS anon_3, (SELECT coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN (fx_trade.side = $12::VARCHAR) THEN fx_trade.input_amount ELSE fx_trade.output_amount END), $13::NUMERIC) AS coalesce_5 
FROM fx_trade 
WHERE fx_trade.pair_id = $14::INTEGER AND fx_trade.created_at >= $15::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE AND fx_trade.created_at < $16::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) AS anon_4, (SELECT coalesce(sum(fx_pool_event.gold_volume), $17::NUMERIC) AS coalesce_7 
FROM fx_pool_event 
WHERE fx_pool_event.pair_id = $18::INTEGER AND fx_pool_event.created_at >= $19::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE AND fx_pool_event.created_at < $20::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE AND fx_pool_event.id > (SELECT fx_market_data_state.last_event_id 
FROM fx_market_data_state 
WHERE fx_market_data_state.pair_id = $21::INTEGER)) AS anon_5

INSERT INTO fx_candle (pair_id, interval, bucket_start, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, gold_volume, n_trades, first_event_at, first_event_id, last_event_at, last_event_id, n_events, updated_at) VALUES ($1::INTEGER, $2::VARCHAR, $3::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, $4::NUMERIC(24, 8), $5::NUMERIC(24, 8), $6::NUMERIC(24, 8), $7::NUMERIC(24, 8), $8::NUMERIC(30, 6), $9::INTEGER, $10::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, $11::BIGINT, $12::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, $13::BIGINT, $14::INTEGER, $15::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE), ($16::INTEGER, $17::VARCHAR, $18::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, $19::NUMERIC(24, 8), $20::NUMERIC(24, 8), $21::NUMERIC(24, 8), $22::NUMERIC(24, 8), $23::NUMERIC(30, 6), $24::INTEGER, $25::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, $26::BIGINT, $27::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, $28::BIGINT, $29::INTEGER, $30::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE), ($31::INTEGER, $32::VARCHAR, $33::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, $34::NUMERIC(24, 8), $35::NUMERIC(24, 8), $36::NUMERIC(24, 8), $37::NUMERIC(24, 8), $38::NUMERIC(30, 6), $39::INTEGER, $40::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, $41::BIGINT, $42::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, $43::BIGINT, $44::INTEGER, $45::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE), ($46::INTEGER, $47::VARCHAR, $48::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, $49::NUMERIC(24, 8), $50::NUMERIC(24, 8), $51::NUMERIC(24, 8), $52::NUMERIC(24, 8), $53::NUMERIC(30, 6), $54::INTEGER, $55::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, $56::BIGINT, $57::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, $58::BIGINT, $59::INTEGER, $60::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) ON CONFLICT (pair_id, interval, bucket_start) DO UPDATE SET open_price = CASE WHEN (excluded.first_event_at < fx_candle.first_event_at OR excluded.first_event_at = fx_candle.first_event_at AND excluded.first_event_id < fx_candle.first_event_id) THEN excluded.open_price ELSE fx_candle.open_price END, high_price = greatest(fx_candle.high_price, excluded.high_price), low_price = least(fx_candle.low_price, excluded.low_price), close_price = CASE WHEN (fx_candle.last_event_at < excluded.last_event_at OR fx_candle.last_event_at = excluded.last_event_at AND fx_candle.last_event_id < excluded.last_event_id) THEN excluded.close_price ELSE fx_candle.close_price END, gold_volume = (fx_candle.gold_volume + excluded.gold_volume), n_trades = (fx_candle.n_trades + excluded.n_trades), first_event_at = CASE WHEN (excluded.first_event_at < fx_candle.first_event_at OR excluded.first_event_at = fx_candle.first_event_at AND excluded.first_event_id < fx_candle.first_event_id) THEN excluded.first_event_at ELSE fx_candle.first_event_at END, first_event_id = CASE WHEN (excluded.first_event_at < fx_candle.first_event_at OR excluded.first_event_at = fx_candle.first_event_at AND excluded.first_event_id < fx_candle.first_event_id) THEN excluded.first_event_id ELSE fx_candle.first_event_id END, last_event_at = CASE WHEN (fx_candle.last_event_at < excluded.last_event_at OR fx_candle.last_event_at = excluded.last_event_at AND fx_candle.last_event_id < excluded.last_event_id) THEN excluded.last_event_at ELSE fx_candle.last_event_at END, last_event_id = CASE WHEN (fx_candle.last_event_at < excluded.last_event_at OR fx_candle.last_event_at = excluded.last_event_at AND fx_candle.last_event_id < excluded.last_event_id) THEN excluded.last_event_id ELSE fx_candle.last_event_id END, n_events = (fx_candle.n_events + excluded.n_events), updated_at = now()

SELECT fx_pair.id, fx_market_data_state.history_ready, fx_market_data_state.history_version, fx_market_data_state.last_event_id, anon_1.window_max, anon_2.anchor_id, anon_2.kind, anon_2.pre_gold_reserve, anon_2.pre_foreign_reserve, anon_2.post_gold_reserve, anon_2.post_foreign_reserve 
FROM fx_pair LEFT OUTER JOIN fx_market_data_state ON fx_market_data_state.pair_id = fx_pair.id JOIN (SELECT max(fx_pool_event.id) AS window_max 
FROM fx_pool_event 
WHERE fx_pool_event.pair_id = $1::INTEGER AND fx_pool_event.created_at >= $2::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE AND fx_pool_event.created_at < $3::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) AS anon_1 ON $5 LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT fx_pool_event.id AS anchor_id, fx_pool_event.kind AS kind, fx_pool_event.pre_gold_reserve AS pre_gold_reserve, fx_pool_event.pre_foreign_reserve AS pre_foreign_reserve, fx_pool_event.post_gold_reserve AS post_gold_reserve, fx_pool_event.post_foreign_reserve AS post_foreign_reserve 
FROM fx_pool_event

 LIMIT $4::INTEGER) AS anon_2 ON $6 
WHERE fx_pair.id = $1::INTEGER
